name: Lysine acetylation and MLL–WDR5 histone methylation
rationale: Members cover histone and non-histone (tubulin) lysine acetylation, and unlike the acetylation-only and general methylation/chromatin confusables they include WDR5/KMT2D (MLL4) histone lysine methyltransferase complexes.

name: Extracellular matrix proteolysis and hyaluronan catabolism
rationale: Members concern breakdown of collagen, elastin and hyaluronan with metalloproteinase activation and endopeptidase/ectodomain-shedding control, distinguishing them from fibrinolysis/contact-activation and collagen-synthesis confusables.

name: Phagosome maturation and its subversion by mycobacteria
rationale: All members concern phagosome acidification, lysosome fusion and related host defences and their blockade by Mtb, whereas confusables cover other pathogens' entry, apoptosis and host metabolism manipulation.

qualifier: G2/M progression and RB1–E2F G1/S control
name: Cell cycle G2/M checkpoint and RB1–E2F G1/S control
rationale: Members span G2/M checkpoint and mitotic entry events plus RB1–E2F and CDK4/6 G1/S control, distinguishing them from E2F-transcription-only and APC/C mitotic-exit confusables.

qualifier: tissue factor/common pathway and factor V
name: Common-pathway coagulation and fibrinolysis including factor V defects
rationale: Members cover coagulation initiation, amplification, fibrin formation, fibrinolysis control and factor V cleavage defects, unlike confusables centred on contact activation, FVIII/FIX or VWF defects.

qualifier: DSCAM, sidekick and nectin heterophilic adhesion
name: Retinal lamination and DSCAM, sidekick, nectin neuronal adhesion
rationale: Members combine retinal neuron differentiation and layer formation with DSCAM/SDK/nectin-mediated adhesion and self-avoidance, distinguishing them from L1-family axonal adhesion and photoreceptor morphogenesis confusables.

qualifier: PML bodies, PKR and arsenite stress
name: Stress granule and PML body dynamics in cellular stress
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly/disassembly, PML bodies, PKR signaling and arsenite response, distinct from heat-shock, proteasome and mRNA-stability confusables.

name: Peroxisomal lipid metabolism with sterol and isoprenoid biosynthesis
rationale: Members span very-long-chain and ether lipid synthesis, alpha-oxidation and peroxisome function together with mevalonate/cholesterol biosynthesis, which the beta-oxidation-focused confusables lack.

name: ERK, ERK5 and atypical MAPK signaling and inactivation
rationale: Members concern RAS–ERK MAPK signaling, its feedback inactivation and the ERK5 and atypical MAPK6/4 cascades, which the phosphatase and JNK/p38 confusables lack.

name: Monocyte inflammatory signaling via heme and endogenous TLR ligands
rationale: Members are monocyte/myeloid inflammatory and defense programs including heme and endogenous-ligand TLR signaling, versus confusables focused on LPS detection, neutrophil degranulation, SIRP or MHC II.

name: Glutathione degradation and transport in gamma-glutamyl cycle
rationale: Members cover glutathione catabolism (GGT1, OPLAH, ACY1 defects) and glutathione/cystine transport, distinct from glutathione synthesis and cystinuria/renal transporter confusables.

name: Cholesterol homeostasis via HDL uptake and efflux restraint
rationale: Members regulate sterol balance through HDL clearance, reverse transport, inhibited efflux and biosynthesis suppression, unlike LDL/SREBP-driven or LXR-promoted efflux confusables.

name: Resolvin, protectin and maresin pro-resolving mediator biosynthesis
rationale: Members are biosynthesis routes for resolvins, protectins, maresins and their HETE precursors, whereas confusables cover lipoxins, leukotrienes and hepoxilins.

name: Microglial activation, proliferation, migration and cytotoxicity
rationale: All members describe microglial effector behaviours, distinct from macrophage CSF signaling and amyloid/neuronal confusables.

qualifier: biliary ABC transport and intestinal sterol absorption
name: Bile acid homeostasis, biliary ABC transport, intestinal sterol absorption
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis, recycling, signaling and secretion plus ABCG5/8, ABCB4, ABCB11 defects and intestinal cholesterol absorption, which distinguish them from alternative-pathway synthesis and lipoprotein confusables.

name: Germline piRNA-mediated transposon silencing and sperm chromatin remodeling
rationale: Members combine piRNA biogenesis and transposon heterochromatin silencing with sperm DNA condensation and gametogenesis, while confusables center on germ cell specification, imprinting and ZGA.

name: Morphogen lipidation and secretion with non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling
rationale: Members cover Wnt and Hedgehog ligand lipidation, autoprocessing and secretion together with Wnt/Ca2+ signaling, unlike Hh-GLI, canonical Wnt and cysteine-palmitoylation confusables.

name: IL-12–driven Th1 differentiation with IFN-γ–induced MHC expression
rationale: Members cover IL-12/JAK-STAT Th1 polarization, IFN-gamma response, MHC regulation and T-cell antigen presentation, distinct from Treg/Th17, IFNG-signaling-regulation and DC IL-12-production confusables.

name: Neutral and imino amino acid and oligopeptide uptake
rationale: Members are SLC6A19/20, SLC36 and peptide cotransporter pathways for glycine, proline, tryptophan and di/oligopeptides, unlike cationic amino acid and urate/cystine confusables.

name: NMDA receptor-dependent synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine remodeling
rationale: Members cover NMDA/AMPA signaling, LTP/LTD, synaptic translation and spine/structural plasticity, which the CREB nuclear-signaling and AMPA/kainate trafficking confusables lack.

name: Retinol and retinal conversion to retinoic acid
rationale: Members cover retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism, distinct from CYP26 catabolism/vitamin A response and visual-cycle confusables.

name: Regulation of atrial and ventricular cardiomyocyte depolarization
rationale: All members regulate depolarization in atrial/ventricular cardiac muscle cells, unlike nodal, conduction-system and repolarization confusables.

name: Viral attachment, entry, protein maturation and virion assembly
rationale: Members cover entry, envelope/structural protein maturation, assembly and host modulation across SARS-CoV, dengue, RSV, influenza and HIV, whereas confusables concern viral genome replication, transcription and translation.

name: DNA damage–induced p53 activation, p21 G1 arrest and apoptosis
rationale: Members cover regulation of TP53 expression/activity and its G1-arrest (p21) and intrinsic-apoptosis outputs, unlike confusables on apoptotic target genes, ARF/p16 cancer defects or TP53 degradation.

qualifier: non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt and glycerol
name: Non-oxidative pentose phosphate, polyol-fructose and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover the non-oxidative pentose phosphate branch (RPIA, TALDO1 defects), polyol-route fructose synthesis and glycerol/alditol metabolism, unlike galactose, glycolysis and glycogen confusables.
